BASE_CSS = """
/* R177: duration is the most important numeric attribute; preserve other semantic badges. */
.v4-session-meta .v177-duration-pill{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#28d8e9 0%,#9b7cff 67%,#ecca55 100%);color:#07121c!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(40,216,233,.12),0 3px 16px rgba(155,124,255,.20)}
@media (forced-colors:active){.v4-session-meta .v177-duration-pill{border:2px solid ButtonText;background:ButtonFace;color:ButtonText!important}}
:root{--bg:#08090b;--panel:#111318;--panel-2:#151820;--panel-3:#0d0f13;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.105);--line-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.18);--text:#f5f7fa;--muted:#a6adb8;--muted-2:#727a87;--cyan:#45d7e8;--green:#25d47a;--orange:#ffab2e;--red:#ff4254;--purple:#9b7cff;--grey:#9098a4;--radius:24px;--radius-sm:16px;--font:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;--display:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;--brand:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;}*{box-sizing:border-box;}html{background:var(--bg);}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;color:var(--text);background: radial-gradient(circle at 13% 0%, rgba(69,215,232,.075), transparent 27%), radial-gradient(circle at 87% 0%, rgba(255,66,84,.075), transparent 28%), var(--bg);font-family:var(--font);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}button,input{font:inherit;}button{cursor:pointer;}.v4-shell{width:min(1440px, calc(100% - 32px));margin:0 auto;padding:22px 0 70px;}.v4-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-bottom:18px;}.v4-brand{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.02em;}.v4839-brand-image{font-size:0;line-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;}.v4839-brand-logo{display:block;width:234px;height:85px;object-fit:contain;flex:0 0 auto;}.v4-top-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}.v4-pill, .v4-logout{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:0 15px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);font-size:13px;font-weight:700;}.v4-pill{color:#c7f8fc;border-color:rgba(69,215,232,.18);}.v4-logout{transition:.18s ease;}.v4-logout:hover{border-color:rgba(255,66,84,.45);background:rgba(255,66,84,.08);transform:translateY(-1px);}.v4-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.025), rgba(255,255,255,.008)), var(--panel);box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.24);overflow:hidden;}.v4-hero{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:26px 24px 28px;margin-bottom:18px;}.v4-hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;width:500px;height:240px;left:50%;top:-185px;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(69,215,232,.12);filter:blur(58px);}.v4-logo{position:relative;width:205px;max-width:55vw;display:block;margin:0 auto 12px;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.38));}.v4-title{position:relative;margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(42px,5.5vw,72px);line-height:1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.018em;}.v4-kicker{position:relative;margin-top:11px;color:var(--cyan);font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;}.v4-subtitle{position:relative;margin:8px auto 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;}.v4-preview-banner{margin:0 0 18px;padding:11px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(69,215,232,.22);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(69,215,232,.055);color:#c9f8fc;font-size:14px;text-align:center;}.v4-preview-banner a{display:inline-flex;margin-left:10px;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:999px;color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;}@media (max-width:720px){.v4839-brand-logo{width:234px;height:85px;max-width:78vw;}}@media print{.v4839-brand-logo{width:58mm;height:auto;}}.v4-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1.25fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:26px;}.v4-control{min-height:310px;padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}.v4-control-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:8px;}.v4-icon{width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);font-size:17px;}.v4-control-title{margin:0;font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;line-height:1.12;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;}.v4-copy{margin:0 0 18px;color:#c1c6ce;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;}.v4-chat-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;}.v4-input{width:100%;height:54px;border:1px solid .v27-report-banner div{min-width:0}.v27-report-banner strong{display:block;font-size:14px;color:#eeeaff}.v27-report-banner span{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#bfc5ce;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.v27-report-banner b{flex:0 0 auto;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid rgba(69,215,232,.28);border-radius:999px;color:#c9f8fc;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em}
.v27-report-mode .v4-controls,.v27-report-mode .v10-ai-chat,.v27-report-mode .v10-preview-flag,.v27-report-mode .v4-preview-banner{display:none!important}
.v27-report-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.v4832-menu-trigger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:0 13px;border:1px solid rgba(98,183,235,.24);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.028);color:#dcecf5;font:900 12px var(--font);letter-spacing:.07em;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;user-select:none;transition:.18s ease}.v4832-menu-trigger:hover,.v4832-menu-trigger[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:rgba(69,215,232,.55);background:rgba(69,215,232,.08);color:#d8fbff}.v4832-menu-trigger.qa{border-color:rgba(155,124,255,.34);color:#e2d9ff;background:rgba(155,124,255,.06)}.v4832-menu-trigger.qa:hover,.v4832-menu-trigger.qa[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:rgba(188,160,255,.65);background:rgba(155,124,255,.13)}
.v4832-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:240;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px}.v4832-modal.is-open{display:flex}.v4832-modal-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.68);backdrop-filter:blur(5px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}.v4832-modal-panel{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(430px,100%);max-height:min(640px,calc(100vh - 36px));overflow:auto;padding:16px;border:1px solid rgba(98,183,235,.24);border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(13,20,28,.995),rgba(8,12,18,.995));box-shadow:0 26px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.58)}.v4832-modal.qa .v4832-modal-panel{border-color:rgba(155,124,255,.36)}.v4832-modal-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:2px 2px 13px}.v4832-modal-title{min-width:0}.v4832-modal-title strong{display:block;font-size:16px;color:#f4f7fa}.v4832-modal-title span{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#8996a3;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}.v4832-modal-close{flex:0 0 auto;width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#e8edf2;font:400 25px/1 var(--font);cursor:pointer}.v4832-modal-close:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#fff}.v4832-modal-actions{display:grid;gap:8px}.v4832-menu-item,.v4832-modal-actions button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;min-height:46px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);color:#dce4ec;text-decoration:none;font:800 13px var(--font);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.v4832-menu-item:hover,.v4832-modal-actions button:hover{border-color:rgba(69,215,232,.18);background:rgba(69,215,232,.09);color:#fff}.v4832-modal-actions form{margin:0}.v4832-menu-note{display:block;padding:0 10px 6px;color:#8996a3;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45}.v4832-menu-sep{height:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.075);margin:3px 2px}
.v4834-qa-run-form{position:relative;border-radius:13px;isolation:isolate}.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running{padding:2px;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(155,124,255,.08)}.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-55%;z-index:-2;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0 65%,rgba(130,92,255,.10) 70%,#a98cff 79%,#55e5ef 86%,transparent 94%);animation:v4834QaTrace 1.15s linear infinite}.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:2px;z-index:-1;border-radius:11px;background:#0d141c}.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running button{position:relative;z-index:1;border-color:transparent!important;background:rgba(21,25,36,.96)!important;color:#f5f2ff!important;cursor:wait}.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running button:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:6px;height:2px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running button:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:6px;width:12%;height:2px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a98cff,#55e5ef);animation:v4834QaFill 16s cubic-bezier(.12,.62,.2,1) forwards}.v4834-qa-run-form button:disabled{opacity:1}.v4834-qa-status{display:none;margin:4px 2px 2px;padding:12px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(155,124,255,.20);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(155,124,255,.07);color:#c9c3d8;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}.v4834-qa-status.is-running{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}.v4834-qa-status i{flex:0 0 auto;width:12px;height:12px;margin-top:2px;border:2px solid rgba(169,140,255,.22);border-top-color:#a98cff;border-right-color:#55e5ef;border-radius:50%;animation:v4834QaSpin .8s linear infinite}.v4834-qa-status strong{display:block;color:#f1edff;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:2px}.v4834-qa-status span{display:block;color:#8e96a4}.v4832-modal.qa.is-qa-running .v4832-modal-close{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}.v4832-modal.qa.is-qa-running .v4832-modal-backdrop{cursor:wait}.v4832-modal.qa.is-qa-running .v4832-menu-note,.v4832-modal.qa.is-qa-running .v4832-menu-sep{opacity:.58}@keyframes v4834QaTrace{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes v4834QaFill{0%{width:12%}38%{width:54%}72%{width:76%}100%{width:88%}}@keyframes v4834QaSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running:before,.v4834-qa-run-form.is-running button:after,.v4834-qa-status i{animation-duration:3s}}
body.v4832-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
.v4831-qa-banner{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin:0 0 18px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(155,124,255,.32);border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(155,124,255,.10),rgba(69,215,232,.035))}.v4831-qa-banner strong{display:block;color:#f0eaff;font-size:14px}.v4831-qa-banner span{display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#bfc8d2;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.v4831-qa-banner b{flex:0 0 auto;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(69,215,232,.3);color:#c8fbff;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em}
html,body{max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
@media(max-width:720px){
  .v4-shell{width:calc(100% - 14px);padding-top:9px;padding-bottom:56px}.v4-card{border-radius:19px}
  .v4-topbar{gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v4-top-actions,.v27-report-actions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}.v4-brand{font-size:32px}
  .v4-logout,.v5-install.is-ready,.v27-report-link{min-height:44px;padding:0 13px;font-size:12px}.v4-hero{padding:18px 13px 20px}.v4-logo{width:160px}.v4-title{font-size:40px}.v4-subtitle{font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}
